tldr: Almost no Canadian big-bank or Wealthsimple news today; BMO's quantum/AI claim is the only direct-competitor item. The notable signals come from fintechs and exchanges: agentic checkout, Google Wallet on iOS, N26's premium tier, Kalshi moving into equities, and Mercado Pago/Mercado Bitcoin operational changes.
themes: Retail access to equities and new asset types
Operational reliability and trust (outages, hacks, funding-method cuts)

highlights.headline: Klarna is now available in Adyen's AI agent checkout (Adyen Agentic), so shoppers can pay with Klarna when an AI agent buys for them.
highlights.why: Payment methods are being built into agent-led shopping, so Simplii's cards and payment options will need to work when an AI agent, not a person, is checking out.

highlights.headline: Google Wallet launched on iOS across the US, bringing payments, tickets and boarding passes into one app.
highlights.why: It raises the bar for wallet experience on iPhone and could pull card use away from bank apps. Simplii should check its own wallet and card provisioning.

highlights.headline: N26 launched Aura, a premium account described as its 'most exclusive' tier, to go after higher-value customers.
highlights.why: A digital-first bank is moving up-market with a paid tier, which is a model Simplii could test for its own affluent segment.

highlights.headline: Kalshi bought broker FB Securities to launch stock and ETF trading. Separately, Mercado Pago added CEDEAR investing in pesos in its app.
highlights.why: Exchanges and wallets are adding brokerage features, so Simplii's trading offer may face more competition for retail investors' attention.
